description: Creates a Stripe Checkout link for one or more custom prints quoted with quote_custom_print, for the person to open and pay in a browser. Nothing is charged by this tool and no order exists until the person pays. Each print is priced again on the server (send checkout_item as quote_custom_print returned it; prices are never taken from the request). Needs the destination ZIP (or country and postal code), since shipping is priced to it. Returns order_link, a drmaker3d.com page that shows the order and opens a fresh payment page, good for 7 days: give the person that. checkout_url is the Stripe page itself, good for two hours. Catalog products, figures, keychains, lithophanes, cake toppers and cookie cutters are bought on their own pages: give the person that page from search_products or print_price_examples.

agent.description: Optional: the name of your agent or service.

email.description: The person's own email, supplied with permission. Required when the instant-price email gate is enabled; never invent an address.

zip.description: U.S. ZIP code it ships to.

name: create_checkout
title: Create a checkout link for custom prints
